statements.text: Because the divisor $0.3$ is between $0$ and $1$, the quotient $30$ is greater than the dividend $9$.
The size of the divisor controls whether the quotient is smaller or larger than the dividend.
A quotient must always be less than the dividend whenever division is used.

teacher.key_rationale: 9÷0.3=30 exceeds the dividend because 0.3 is between 0 and 1; divisor size decides the comparison. Statement 3 is the false always-smaller rule. Key is 1 and 2 only.
